description: PEP precision provides sufficient headroom for chained divisions that produce a repeating decimal
halfUp() rounds ties away from zero (HALF_UP), symmetric for negative values, no banker's rounding
No native binary-float artifact anywhere in the arithmetic chain (0.1+0.2 exact)
ceilDecimal() has no epsilon slop at exact integer boundaries
parseDecimalField rejects Infinity/-Infinity/NaN/exponent notation/hex-looking values/thousands separators/currency symbols
Leading/trailing zero, leading/trailing decimal point, explicit +/-, negative-zero normalization
Format-then-parse round-trip preserves the intended money value for any supported cents amount
isPositiveDivisor rejects zero and values below MIN_POSITIVE_DIVISOR (1e-9)
Extremely long numeric strings, mixed alphanumeric input, unicode whitespace are rejected, not silently coerced
Gross wall area = 2*(length+width)*height, decimal feet retained
Ceiling area = length*width
Quick-mode opening deduction: doorCount*doorArea + windowCount*windowArea, exact quick-mode constants (20/15 ft2)
Detailed opening deduction sums each opening's own width*height*count, never averaged across differently-sized openings
Opening deduction exactly at gross area is valid (net=0); one unit above gross is invalid, never a clamped/zero-area complete surface
Trim paintable area = length*developedWidth
Door paintable area = count*width*height*paintedSides (1 or 2), no implicit averaging across differently-sized doors
Boundary sweep of room dimensions from minimum-smallest-unit through maximum+smallest-unit (MAX_ROOM_DIMENSION_FT)
rawDemandGal = area*coats*(1+waste)/coverage, waste and coats each applied exactly once
Same-variant demand pools across ALL rooms/surfaces before purchasing; purchased = ceil(pooled raw), exact boundaries never overbuy
Different colors/variants never pool -- each keeps its own independent ceiling
Disabled surfaces (even with huge invalid-looking stale geometry) contribute zero demand
Zero-demand surfaces never force a purchase (purchasedGallons(0)=0, no minimum-1-gallon floor)
Exact-boundary sweep (just below/at/just above 1gal, 2gal, and arbitrary purchase increments)
Price Book Health uses fractional consumption-based costing per unit, never whole-can-purchase rounding noise
wallOrCeilingHours = area*coats/throughput; trimHours = length*coats/throughput
doorHours = hoursPerSidePerCoat*count*sides*coats -- a fixed per-side-per-coat allowance, not an area/throughput rate

Surface labor COST is computed via a fused multiply-then-divide (area*coats*rate/throughput), not by multiplying a separately-truncated hours intermediate -- avoids losing an exact cancellation to premature rounding
Additional labor lines are summed once, added to surface labor, never double-counted
Missing/zero/negative throughput or rate is rejected upstream (blocks completion), never silently becomes zero-hour labor
Other material line cost = quantity*unitCost, summed across lines
Supplies allowance: only the ACTIVE mode (none/flat/paintPercent) contributes; stale inactive-mode values (blank/malformed/negative/above-range) never leak in
paintPercent supplies mode applies its ratio to PAINT cost only, never total materials
directCost = materials + labor + otherExpenses (exact decomposition, not re-derived)
overhead = directCost * overheadRatio, applied exactly once; jobCost = directCost + overhead
Overhead ratio boundary sweep: 0%, 1%, 15%, 33.333%, 50%, 75%, 100%, just-below-0%, just-above-100%

description: requiredPriceRaw = cost/(1-target), rejects target outside [0,1), reports out_of_supported_range above MAX_REQUIRED_PRICE
minimumTargetPrice is the MINIMUM cent that meets target (ceiling), never nearest-cent approximation which can undershoot
margin = profit/price (null if price<=0); markup = profit/cost (null if cost<=0) -- never substituted for each other
unpriced (price=null) vs explicit zero_price (price=0) are distinct states with distinct profit/margin semantics
Negative profit (price below cost) is NEVER clamped to zero or positive
Status derivation: below_cost / below_target / at_target / above_target boundaries exact, not off-by-one-cent
Target margin boundary sweep: 0, 0.01, 0.10, 0.20, 0.35, 0.50, 0.75, 0.90, 0.99, 0.999, 1.0(rejected), negative(rejected), >1.0(rejected)
test_reference: tests/domain/boundaryMatrix.test.ts, tests/differential/oracleFixtures.test.ts (random targetMarginRatio 0-0.6 in valid_project fixtures)

description: Custom price persists across cost changes; suggested price recomputes live
Line total = halfUp(qty*unitPrice, 2); subtotal = SUM of rounded lines (not round(sum(raw)))
Tax = halfUp(subtotal*taxRatio, 2), applied to the ROUNDED subtotal, not raw
Sum-of-rounded-lines vs round(sum(raw)) legitimately differ by a cent for lines like two $12.005 entries -- both paths independently verified
Explicit no-charge ($0 total) requires confirmation, never silently printable
Untouched default rows never count as a valid described line; print stays blocked
Materials mode (lumpSum|itemized), labor mode (direct|hoursRate), overhead mode (percent|flat) never blend stale inactive-mode values on switch
Original spec fixture and homepage illustrative fixture both independently verified against the oracle
Materials-only / labor-only / expense-only / zero-cost jobs each produce a correct, non-fabricated result
Walls-only / ceiling-only / walls+ceiling, quick vs detailed openings, all supported coats and waste
Baseline documented fixture (20x16x9, 2 doors+3 windows, 2 coats, 350 coverage, 0.10 waste, $42/gal) independently verified against the oracle
Enabling labor with a blank rate blocks the result (rate-required message), never a $0 labor line
A room built in the free calculator hands off into Pro exactly, no entered prep time/opening/surface/dimension silently dropped
Prep hours become an additionalLabor line at the DESTINATION's rate, never the free tool's own rate (disclosed via unsupportedFieldNotes)
New draft copies current settings/catalog into its OWN activeRateSnapshot; never re-pulled on autosave
Service default-refresh preview reports only customized (non-null) fields, never phantom differences for untouched fields
Wall and ceiling in the same room may use DIFFERENT paint variants; pooling is variant-keyed, never surface-kind-keyed
Standalone trim/door surfaces (roomId=null) compute identically to room-attached ones
An enabled-and-invalid surface blocks the WHOLE project -- never a partial total
Zero enabled surfaces is treated as invalid/empty, not a zero-cost complete project
Full project assembly pipeline (surfaces -> materials -> labor -> direct cost -> overhead -> job cost -> price) matches an independent oracle exactly across 100,000 randomly generated valid projects
Reordering rooms/surfaces changes display order only -- totals and IDs unchanged
Renaming a room changes NO calculated total
The estimate summary's displayed components reconcile exactly to the displayed total; a rounding-adjustment row appears only when needed
Null currentSellingPrice prompts entry, never a false 0%/alarming status
A price below modeled cost shows a genuine negative margin, never clamped to zero
Modeled cost per unit agrees exactly with an independent oracle across 10,000 randomly generated services
Known cent-boundary case: nearest-cent rounding would remain below target; minimum target price rounds upward
Finalization requires ALL FOUR categories confirmed with a non-null amount; partial state is 'in_progress', never a fabricated total
actualMargin gated on baselinePrice>0 REGARDLESS of profit's sign -- a loss still shows a real negative margin, never suppressed
AGG-005: four individually-valid category amounts can still sum past MAX_AGGREGATE_MONETARY -> out_of_supported_range, never a fabricated 'final' total
Baseline overhead allocation mode reads the FROZEN issued value directly, never re-parsed as free text
Editing an already-entered actual amount REPLACES it -- delta reflects only the new value, never a sum
totalVariance = actualCost - estimatedJobCost, sign preserved (profit and loss both real)
Negative actual expense is invalid, never silently zeroed/clamped -- blocks finalization
Saved drafts use FROZEN rate snapshots; live catalog changes never alter an already-saved draft's calculation
Rate refresh preview shows exact differences per variant/setting field; cancel changes nothing; confirm changes only the previewed assumptions
Refresh followed by undo restores IDENTICAL calculated outputs to the pre-refresh state
A new draft created from an issued revision starts with NO preRefreshCheckpoint of its own (BACK-027 fix)
Issuing freezes calculated outputs (frozen jobCost/overhead/etc, schemaVersion-stamped); a frozen read never re-derives from a possibly-changed live formula
An issued document is frozen and never recomputed, even after the app's own engineVersion moves on
Editing an issued revision always creates ONE new draft revision, never mutates the original
Every decimal field in an import is re-validated against the SAME MAX_* constants the calculation engine uses
Exported then restored/imported-as-copy produces byte-identical calculated results to the pre-export state (baseline overhead value rounding fix, BACK-028)
Import-as-copy remaps IDs but never re-derives or alters any numerical value
No partial writes for an invalid/corrupt import -- validation happens before any write
Room count, surface count, combined document-line count boundary sweep against MAX_ROOMS_PER_PROJECT/MAX_SURFACES_PER_PROJECT/MAX_DOCUMENT_LINES_PER_PROJECT
Total area, raw paint demand, purchased gallons boundary sweep against MAX_AREA_FT2/MAX_AGGREGATE_GALLONS
Total labor hours, material/labor/direct cost, overhead, job cost, required price, custom price, actual cost boundary sweep against MAX_AGGREGATE_MONETARY/MAX_AGGREGATE_HOURS/MAX_REQUIRED_PRICE
At-limit values remain valid; above-limit values become explicitly out_of_supported_range -- never a partial plausible total, never Infinity/NaN/silent saturation
Draft saving remains possible when out-of-range; issuing is blocked
Previously-issued frozen values retain their original figures even if a later build's limits change (compatibility, not re-validated retroactively)
Free job-cost calculator and the core pricing engine agree on identical cost/price/margin for equivalent assumptions
Free interior calculator and Pro room/surface engine agree for equivalent geometry/paint/labor assumptions
Pro estimate summary total equals the customer-document total exactly (issued, frozen)
Pro estimate vs Price Book Health unit model agree when assumptions are equivalent (both route through the same overhead/pricing primitives)

description: Saved/reopened calculation matches the original in-memory calculation exactly (frozen snapshot re-read, not re-derived)
Rate-refresh-then-undo matches the pre-refresh result byte-for-byte
buildCustomerDocument is an ALLOW-LIST projection; a new private field is absent BY CONSTRUCTION unless deliberately added
No internal cost/labor/material/overhead/profit/margin figure ever appears as a customer-document field
A complete-but-not-yet-issued draft shows PRICE PENDING, never a computed number before actual issue
